nodes.name: Delivery Status Webhook
nodes.notes: Register this URL as a Transactional Webhook in Brevo's dashboard (Transactional > Settings > Webhooks), subscribed to at least 'delivered' and the bounce/error events. Confirmed against Brevo's public webhook event docs (developers.brevo.com/docs/how-to-use-webhooks) for the payload shape. Multitexter's docs don't document a delivery-status webhook at all, so SMS delivery status stays 'sent' (never flips to 'delivered'/'failed') unless Multitexter support confirms one exists.

parameters.query: UPDATE message_log SET status = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE provider_message_id = $1;
